name: Log Shattering / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
details: For every finite binary class, log shattering is at least the largest strongly shattered-set size.
proof: A strongly shattered set of size $d$ contains a full $d$-cube, hence every one of its $2^d$ subsets is shattered. Therefore $|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|\geq2^d$ and $\log_2|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|\geq d$.
